rules.desc: RULE_1: Strong Liberal Democrat incumbent holds seat
RULE_2: Labour wins with clear lead
RULE_3: Reform UK upsets Labour incumbent
rules.cond: r['incumbent'] == 'Labour' and share(r, 'Reform UK') > 20 and (top1(r)[0] == 'Reform UK' or (top1(r)[0] == 'Labour' and top2(r)[0] == 'Reform UK' and margin12(r) <= 15))

rules.desc: RULE_4: Conservative incumbent holds in close race
rules.cond: r['incumbent'] == 'Conservative' and share(r, 'Conservative') > 20 and (top1(r)[0] == 'Conservative' or (top2(r)[0] == 'Conservative' and margin12(r) < 1))

raw:
RULE_1: Strong Liberal Democrat incumbent holds seat
CONDITION: r['incumbent'] == 'Liberal Democrat' and share(r, 'Liberal Democrat') > 20
PREDICT: Liberal Democrat

RULE_2: Labour wins with clear lead
CONDITION: top1(r)[0] == 'Labour' and margin12(r) > 10
PREDICT: Labour

RULE_3: Reform UK upsets Labour incumbent
CONDITION: r['incumbent'] == 'Labour' and share(r, 'Reform UK') > 20 and (top1(r)[0] == 'Reform UK' or (top1(r)[0] == 'Labour' and top2(r)[0] == 'Reform UK' and margin12(r) <= 15))
PREDICT: Reform UK

RULE_4: Conservative incumbent holds in close race
CONDITION: r['incumbent'] == 'Conservative' and share(r, 'Conservative') > 20 and (top1(r)[0] == 'Conservative' or (top2(r)[0] == 'Conservative' and margin12(r) < 1))
PREDICT: Conservative

RULE_5: Green Party wins in specific London boroughs or with strong lead
CONDITION: (r['council'] in ['Waltham Forest', 'Hackney', 'Norwich'] and share(r, 'Green') > 15) or (top1(r)[0] == 'Green' and margin12(r) > 5
